Pimozide enhances the effects of hyoscyamine spray through pharmacodynamic synergy. Hyoscyamine spray reduces pimozide levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption, applicable only to oral forms of both drugs. Additionally, hyoscyamine spray decreases pimozide levels via pharmacodynamic antagonism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 3. Drugs with anticholinergic effects may potentiate botulinum toxin effects, leading to excessive neuromuscular weakness and heightened systemic anticholinergic effects.
